bio: This restaurant with a pleasingly buzzing atmosphere is André Kähler's wonderful alternative to his fine dining The O'ROOM, also in the Marc O'Polo Strandcasino concept store, just a stone's throw from the sea and the promenade. A modern take on regional dishes is served in an attractive, trendy setting. You sit on the raised gallery and look down onto the store; some tables also have a view of the kitchen. In summer, the terrace out front beckons....
